reviewNotes: Unreviewed AI release-description drafts only. The buyer-agreed recorded denomination stays fixed; no exchange conversion or inclusion of other currencies in rand totals is claimed. Existing four notice languages only; no human or fluent approval.

messages.english: Choose the currency for each new invoice.

translations.zu: Khetha uhlobo lwemali lwe-invoyisi ngayinye entsha.
translations.st: Kgetha mofuta wa tjhelete bakeng sa invoice e nngwe le e nngwe e ntjha.
translations.ts: Hlawula muxaka wa mali eka invoyisi yin’wana ni yin’wana leyintshwa.
translations.ve: Khethani lushaka lwa tshelede lwa invoisi iṅwe na iṅwe ntswa.

translations.st: Boloka mefuta ya tjhelete ya di-invoice e hlakile
translations.ts: Endla leswaku mixaka ya mali ya ti-invoyisi yi va erivaleni
translations.ve: Itani uri tshaka dza tshelede dza dzi-invoisi dzi vhe khagala

translations.st: Invoice → Mofuta wa tjhelete wa invoice ena
translations.ts: Invoyisi → Muxaka wa mali wa invoyisi leyi
translations.ve: Invoisi → Lushaka lwa tshelede lwa invoisi iyi

messages.english: Choose the currency agreed with the buyer. Saved invoices keep their currency; amounts are not converted, and other currencies stay separate from rand totals.

translations.zu: Khetha uhlobo lwemali ovumelene ngalo nomthengi. Ama-invoyisi agciniwe agcina uhlobo lwawo lwemali; amanani awaguqulelwa kolunye uhlobo lwemali, kanti ezinye izinhlobo zemali zihlala zihlukile ezibalweni eziphelele zerandi.
translations.st: Kgetha mofuta wa tjhelete oo o dumellaneng le moreki ka wona. Di-invoice tse bolokilweng di boloka mofuta wa tsona wa tjhelete; dipalo tsa tjhelete ha di fetolelwe mofuteng o mong wa tjhelete, mme mefuta e meng ya tjhelete e dula e arohane le dikakaretso tsa diranta.
translations.ts: Hlawula muxaka wa mali lowu pfumelelaniweke na muxavi. Ti-invoyisi leti hlayisiweke ti hlayisa muxaka wa tona wa mali; mintsengo a yi hundzuluxeriwi eka mali yin’wana, naswona mixaka yin’wana ya mali yi hlayisiwa yi hambanile ni mintsengo ya tirhandi.
translations.ve: Khethani lushaka lwa tshelede lwe na tendelana na murengi ngaḽo. Dzi-invoisi dzo vhulungwaho dzi dzula na lushaka lwadzo lwa tshelede; mbalo dza tshelede a dzi shandukiswi dza vha kha luṅwe lushaka lwa tshelede, nahone dziṅwe tshaka dza tshelede dzi dzula dzo fhambana na ṱhanganyelo dza rand.
